title: Add an XML sitemap and reference it in robots.txt
rationale: robots.txt has no Sitemap line and no sitemap route exists, so new tool pages depend on link discovery.
acceptance: Given the site is built, When /sitemap.xml is requested, Then it lists every indexable tool page with an absolute URL
Given robots.txt is requested, When it is read, Then it contains a Sitemap line with the absolute sitemap URL

title: Dedicated page for resizing images to a target size in KB
rationale: SERP for the target-size query is dominated by single-purpose tool pages; the current generic resizer has no page for it.
acceptance: Given a user opens /resize-image-to-20kb, When they upload a JPG and choose 20 KB, Then the download is at most 20 KB
Given the page is fetched without JavaScript, When the HTML is read, Then it has a unique title, H1 and how-to text
risks: near-duplicate pages per size would be thin content; one page with presets instead

title: Verify Search Console and define tool funnel events
rationale: No Search Console verification and no tool usage events, so no landing-page or funnel data exists.
acceptance: Done when the Search Console domain property is verified and the four funnel events appear in the analytics debug view

title: Answer photo-size questions in the job-applications community as the disclosed brand account
rationale: Members ask how to meet form photo limits; rules allow self-promotion links only in the weekly thread, so answers elsewhere carry no link.
risks: ban risk outside the weekly thread
acceptance: Done when three helpful answers are posted from the disclosed brand account, without links unless the thread rules allow one

title: Hold display ads until helpful content and consent banner are in place
rationale: Tool pages carry little unique text; AdSense policies require valuable inventory and a consent solution for EEA and UK users.
acceptance: Done when the readiness table in monetization.md has no missing rows
